messages:
Evan (AE): FYI — GatewayBank kickoff 9am PT tomorrow. They want a 10-day hands-on trial with clear pass/fail metrics. Need harness and success gates finalized by EOD.
Rita (Solutions): Short plan: focus on two flows: refund triage (primary) + dispute summary (secondary). Keep goldens small: 20 core prompts + 10 adversarial probes.
Sam (SE): Agree on lean goldens. Suggest 3 structured fields for refunds (reason_code, amount, action) to score deterministically. Free-text summaries scored semantically.
Lina (Security): Security hits: customer requires EU-only processing and KMS-managed key controls for artifacts. For trial use sanitized demo data and token redaction. I'll send a one-page note they can sign.
Maya (CS): Onboarding ops: we'll ship a tiny CLI that runs the harness locally and a scheduled hosted job every 12h. Dashboard will show weighted score trend + PII alerts.
Rita (Solutions): Scoring proposal: structured fields (0/1 each), summary semantic (0-2), safety penalty (0-1). Weighted = 0.55*structured + 0.35*semantic + 0.10*(1 - safety_penalty). Regression gate: candidate must not drop >2% vs baseline.
Sam (SE): Quick scorer snippet to drop into harness:
```python
from difflib import SequenceMatcher

def sem_score(pred, gold):
    r = SequenceMatcher(None, pred, gold).ratio()
    return 2 if r>0.85 else 1 if r>0.6 else 0
```
Evan (AE): Pricing: they asked about a short Dedicated trial. We can offer a 10-day Dedicated bench if they cover pilot cost. Legal needs to approve.
Rita (Solutions): Add cost-estimator subcommand to the CLI to project token spend at their expected QPS. I'll include it.
Lina (Security): Also flag: any PII leakage or hallucinated legal advice = immediate stop.
Maya (CS): Customer-facing gates suggestion:
- Gate A: weighted score >= 0.77 on goldens + p95 latency < 400ms.
- Gate B: simulated escalation reduction >= 25%.
- Hard stop: PII leakage or high-severity safety hit.
Evan (AE): Action items:
- @Sam: CLI + cost estimator (EOD).
- @Lina: one-pager on trial data controls (today).
- @Maya: dashboard template + adversarial set (tomorrow AM).
- @Rita: finalize goldens and regression baseline (EOD).
deploy-bot: eu-west-1 sandbox ready :white_check_mark:
Evan (AE): Thanks team — I'll share at kickoff and note the regression gate and Dedicated pilot option. :thumbsup:
